content.short: Bespoke digital art that strives to create longterm value on the Cardano and Ergo blockchains.
content.description:
H.Y.P.E. or How You Perceive Everything is a project comprised of a small team of creatives, marketing professions, and eUTXO experts aiming to add value to the Cardano ecosystem by introducing cutting edge blockchain-based technology and industry-grade, professional artwork. The creative team is led by a multi-disciplinary artist & award-winning Creative Director of Okperfect.

The H.Y.P.E. team recognizes the limitless potential of eUTXO blockchains for creators and aims to push the envelope and advance the level of creative work within the Cardano ecosystem. We aim to empower our collectors and inspire a new generation of visual artists within the community.
